gazetteerRecord.coordinateRole: Approximate GeoNames feature point; not an official river vertex, station, or boundary.
gazetteerRecord.termsCaveat: GeoNames supplies data as-is without a warranty of accuracy, timeliness, or completeness. Attribution is required.

modelledNetworkCrosscheck.method: Project the GeoNames point to EPSG:3857 and compute planar point-to-polyline distance against the published modelled stream network. Approximate ground distance is also shown with a latitude cosine correction.
modelledNetworkCrosscheck.interpretation: The nearest modelled feature is about 1.57 km from the gazetteer point. This is too distant to use as a name-to-channel match; small channels may be absent from the model and the gazetteer point may be approximate.

limitations: GeoNames is a gazetteer, not an authoritative channel survey; its coordinate is a single approximate feature point.
The University of Glasgow stream lines are modelled from a 2013 elevation dataset and do not constitute an official named-river geometry.
The nearest modelled segment is too far from the point for a confident name crosswalk. The distance does not disprove that the named river exists.
No official Gapan/Sapang reach station, channel trace, fish survey, salinity measurement, access determination, or current legal status was established.
nextAction: Seek an official or otherwise independently validated channel trace and station-level source for the Gapan/Sapang reach. Until then keep the GeoNames feature point and modelled line out of public map geometry and preserve the lead as unresolved.
